summary: Executed backend+frontend regression focused on Pump.fun integration layer, launch deprecation behavior, Pump verification guards, world preservation signals, and Pump/Jupiter dashboard routing. Full backend pytest suite passed with updated /api/launches expectation and added Pump security tests.
action_items: Optional final manual wallet-connected smoke test: Launch verify/import happy-path with a real creator wallet in browser extension.
Keep pytest invocation at -n 0 or retain idempotent fixture upserts to avoid xdist duplicate fixture collisions.
critical_code_review_comments: No fee-construction or fee-redirection code observed; Pump fee ownership remains delegated to Pump.fun.
Pump provenance is validated by on-chain/program checks in verifier+market layers, not mint suffix heuristics.
Legacy independent launch route is intentionally disabled and now correctly returns 410 for authenticated callers.
seed_data_creation: Pytest fixtures create temporary TEST_* token/bounty/submission data and teardown cleanup. Post-run verification: /api/world tokens=16, /api/bounties=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 34/34 tests pass (including new Pump security/auth/provenance checks). Frontend automation validated world render, launch UI contract, FARTCOIN Pump panel/link/toggle/trades scope, JUP Jupiter panel, and mobile overflow checks (390px) with no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: Testing infra issue found and fixed: session autouse fixture in conftest used insert_one, causing DuplicateKeyError under pytest-xdist multi-worker setup. Mitigation applied: switched to idempotent upsert ($setOnInsert) for test token and bounty fixtures.
